title: allium sphaerocephalon var. sardoum
intro: Allium sphaerocephalon var. sardoum, commonly known as Globe Garlic, is a variety of the Allium sphaerocephalon plant, which belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. It is known for its health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, reducing blood pressure, and acting as an antibacterial and antifungal agent. The plant's therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Globe Garlic include compounds such as allicin, alliin, and sulfur-containing compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
